description: Defines the DeprecatedTypeProperties class which specifies a Backend and ScalarType, providing methods for type and device information, and constructing TensorOptions.

classes.name: DeprecatedTypeProperties
classes.description: Represents a combination of Backend and ScalarType, providing methods to query type properties, convert to TensorOptions, and create tensors or storage from pointers.

methods.name: layout
methods.description: Returns the layout based on backend.

methods.name: is_sparse_csr
methods.description: Checks if layout is sparse CSR.

methods.name: typeMeta
methods.description: Returns the TypeMeta for the scalar type.

methods.name: toScalarType
methods.description: Returns DeprecatedTypeProperties for specified scalar type.

methods.name: options
methods.description: Constructs TensorOptions from type and device index or device.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Returns a unique ID for the type.

methods.name: unsafeTensorFromTH
methods.description: Creates a Tensor from a raw pointer.

methods.name: unsafeStorageFromTH
methods.description: Creates Storage from a raw pointer.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies a tensor with optional device transfer.
